response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT PlaylistId, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM PlaylistTrack GROUP BY PlaylistId), avg_c AS (SELECT AVG(track_count * 1.0) AS avg_count FROM counts) SELECT c.PlaylistId, c.track_count, c.track_count * 1.0 / a.avg_count AS ratio FROM counts c CROSS JOIN avg_c a ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Track count is the number of PlaylistTrack rows per playlist; the average is taken across playlists present in PlaylistTrack, as the request states.
Ties at the 10th position are broken arbitrarily by LIMIT 10 since no tiebreaker is specified.
